stemMd: An elevation’s dimension chain lists adjacent bay widths of 2.4 m, 3.6 m and 2.4 m. The outer endpoints match the overall dimension endpoints. What overall width is consistent?
explanationMd: With adjacent, non-overlapping bays between the same endpoints, the overall dimension is their sum. Adding2.4+3.6+2.4 gives8.4 m. This checks consistency between chain and overall dimensions.

distractorRationale.c: This treats all three bays as2.4 m.
distractorRationale.d: This overstates the sum of the stated widths.
distractorRationale.e: This is only the middle bay width.
